description: Connect a custom domain. Omit landingPageId for the legacy workspace-wide domain, or provide it to dedicate the hostname to one page at the domain root. Returns DNS and verification details.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

domain.description: Custom domain: a subdomain (pages.example.com, needs a CNAME record) or a root domain (example.com, needs an A record to 76.76.21.21; www also redirects to the root when its CNAME points to pages.sequenzydns.com).

landingPageId.description: Optional landing page ID. When provided, the domain serves only this page from the hostname root.

name: connect_landing_page_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `connect_landing_page_domain` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

landingPage.description: The landing page record returned by Sequenzy.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
